request.style: English, intimate acoustic singer-songwriter, soft breathy male vocal, fingerpicked steel-string guitar, cello, light piano, honest and searching, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They came to me with open hands and said we've seen the Lord
I shook my head and turned away, I would not take their word
Unless I see the mark of nails and touch them with my hand
Unless I touch his wounded side, I cannot understand

[Verse]
Eight days later we were gathered and the doors were locked again
He came and stood among us and he spoke to all of them
Peace be with you, said the Master, and he turned his eyes to me
He did not scold, he did not shame, he showed his hands to me

[Pre-Chorus]
Put your finger here
Look at my hands
Reach out your hand and put it into my side
Stop doubting and believe

[Chorus]
My Lord and my God
My Lord and my God
Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed

[Bridge]
We never saw the empty tomb, we never touched his hand
But the word has come to us across the sea and land
So we are in the blessing that he spoke inside that room
For those who have not seen him risen from the tomb

[Chorus]
My Lord and my God
My Lord and my God
Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed

[Outro]
My Lord and my God
